How to get funded with
a crypto prop firm?

Start the Challenge

Pick your account size and pay the challenge deposit, or the challenge fee on Zero-Step. On One-Step and Two-Step the deposit comes back with your first payout. The Zero-Step fee is not refundable once you activate the challenge.

All systems operational

All trading on HyroTrader takes place on simulated (demo) accounts that run on real exchange market data. There is no real-capital stage at any point. HyroTrader is not a broker, does not accept deposits for trading, and does not provide investment services, investment advice or portfolio management. Where you connect your own Bybit or BloFin demo account, that account is yours; the simulated balance HyroTrader allocates to a challenge or funded account is not, and a payout is a contractual share of simulated trading performance. Where you trade through a third-party exchange or terminal, you must meet that provider's own terms and eligibility rules and comply with the law of your country. The Tealstreet and Tiger terminals are not available to traders in the United States or in countries where Bybit is restricted, and you must not use a VPN or any other means to get around that. The evaluation is a genuine test of risk management, and many traders do not pass. HyroTrader's revenue comes from challenge fees. Trading financial markets carries high risk. Nothing on this site is a recommendation to trade, and it is not directed at residents of any jurisdiction where that would be contrary to local law. HyroTrader is operated by HYRO TECHNOLOGIES FZ-LLC, RAKEZ, Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates. Funded accounts are provided by HYROTRADER TECHNOLOGIES LTD, Intershore Chambers, Road Town, Tortola, British Virgin Islands. For customers in the European Economic Area and the United Kingdom, card payments are handled by Hyro Finance, j. s. a., Bratislava, Slovak Republic.
